title: Soliton like solutions of $λφ^4$ theory in de Sitter space
summary: We study classical solutions of a scalar field with quartic potential in de Sitter space-time. Using the ansatz $φ=F(X\cdotξ)$, via embeding coordinate $X_α$ of the ambiend space we find several families of analytic solutions classified by the causal character of the constant vector $ξ$. For time-like $ξ$, the solutions are globally regular and describe either global oscillations around a minimum or global vacuum transition; for space-like $ξ$, they are singular in the global patch but regular in the open slicing.
